name: design-duel
description: A design contest in one command: /design-duel <topic> has claude, codex and agy each propose a design alone (read-only), then score each other's proposals under anonymous labels with their strongest objection; the mod tallies the scores, the band names the winner, and the winning design goes into the prompt for Claude to build when asked

duelists.title: Duelists
duelists.description: Comma-separated duelists: claude, codex, agy; all three by default

revise.title: Revise round
revise.description: After the scoring, each author answers the objections and revises its proposal, and the revised proposals are scored again; off by default

timeoutMin.title: Timeout (minutes)
timeoutMin.description: How long one duel may run, all rounds together, before the duelists still going are stopped; 30 by default
